The bandage features a custom hand-drawn illustration in black ink depicting a cartoonish figure with red accents, along with a horizontal black line and red zigzag marks. Two human fingertips are visible pressing down on the right side of the bandage.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The hand-drawn ink lines appear slightly 'smudged' or blended into the porous fabric texture of the bandage. While physically plausible for marker-on-fabric, AI generators often struggle with this specific interaction, sometimes creating unnatural bleeding or floating effects. Here it looks mostly correct but lacks crisp edge definition against the perforated background.

The edges of the fingertips pressing the bandage show slight softness and minor merging with the background/skin tone. The nail bed of the lower finger lacks sharp definition and appears slightly waxy or melted, a common subtle artifact in AI-generated hands.
